title: Cheshire pilot claims UFO sightings during night flights over Brussels
excerpt: A Cheshire pilot has claimed he spotted UFOs whilst flying commercial planes over Brussels, and he says he is not the only one
content:
A pilot claims he has witnessed UFOs while operating planes over Brussels. Steve Frazer, 48, has been a captain for flying commercial aircraft for more than two decades, and in 2022 first observed what appeared to be an aircraft circling over land near Brussels.

Since then he has seen the same flashing lights "six or seven" times, most recently in October 2026, initially mistaking them for a military aircraft that might be refuelling. Time lapsed footage Steve recorded mid-flight shows what seems to be small orbs of light darting across the sky before vanishing.

Steve says he's not the only one who has reported the unusual lights, with other pilots remarking on them after he investigated the phenomenon online.

Steve, from Sandbach, Cheshire, says: "I saw these lights when I was working and another colleague saw the lights coming back from Lithuania.

"We saw them in the same space and roughly the same direction but it was ever so strange.

"I just thought it was a military refuelling aircraft but the way it was moving and speed, it didn't make any sense.

"We were going towards them for seemingly ages and never got to them.

"That was a few years ago and I didn't think much about it.

"I did a couple of flights recently and saw them again.

"I've been flying 27 years commercially and it doesn't fit with anything I've seen previously.

"Technically in a sense it's an unidentified object that seems to be flying.

"It looked to me it was coming over the Atlantic, it looked beyond the UK."

Steve says he is not the only one to have spotted the orbs, with a fellow pilot getting in touch via radio to enquire about any military activity last month.

"I've done my own digging to try and figure out what they are and I can't find an answer to it," he told Talk to the Press.

"I know what satellites normally look like, I've seen plenty of Starlinks and things like that.

"They don't fit with that movement.

"In the little video you see the lights coming up from the ground and I seem to recall it was Brussels coming into view back towards the UK - it's always north-westerly heading.

"I've done a little research online and other people have reported this but I don't think anyone has recorded it, not that I've seen anyway.

"Some people flying in the Netherlands saw it as well and made a report through a media channel but I'm not entirely sure.

"It seems to fit with what other pilots have commented on when they've seen them."
